artists.biography: Pop Will Eat Itself (also known as PWEI or The Poppies) are an English alternative rock band, originally formed in Stourbridge in 1986, with members from Birmingham, Coventry and the Black Country. Initially known as a Grebo act, their style changed to incorporate sample driven indie and industrial rock. Their highest charting single was 1993's "Get The Girl! Kill The Baddies!". After initially disbanding in 1996, and having a brief reformation in 2005, they issued their first release in over five years in 2010.

perplexity.description:
This Is the Day...This Is the Hour...This Is This! is the second studio album by English rock band Pop Will Eat Itself, released in May 1989 on RCA Records. The album represents the band's evolution into a more experimental sound that blends electronic production with hip-hop influences and rock sensibilities. With a runtime of approximately 44 minutes, the record showcases the group's willingness to incorporate sampling, programmed drums, and rap-influenced vocal delivery alongside traditional rock instrumentation, positioning them within the emerging alternative and industrial rock landscape of the late 1980s.

As the band's sophomore effort, the album marked a significant step forward in their artistic development following their debut. The incorporation of hip-hop elements and electronic textures reflected broader trends in alternative music during this period, where artists were increasingly cross-pollinating genres and embracing digital production techniques. The album's ambitious sonic palette and genre-blending approach helped establish Pop Will Eat Itself as innovators within the UK alternative scene, contributing to their growing reputation as a band willing to challenge conventional rock structures and expectations.
